slide1.headline: OpenAI Cuts GPT-5.6 Luna and Terra API Prices
slide1.subtitle: Up to 80% price reduction

slide2.title: WHAT HAPPENED
lines: Event date: 31 Jul 2026
OpenAI dropped GPT-5.6 Luna and Terra API prices by up to 80%
The price reduction is a response to growing competition in the AI market
The new prices will make OpenAI's AI models more accessible to developers

slide3.title: WHY IT MATTERS
lines: The price reduction will increase the adoption of OpenAI's AI models
The move is expected to put pressure on other AI companies to reduce their prices
Source: InfoWorld, 31 Jul 2026
